text: On the Grafana dashboard 'fwgr72-n1 Bench Dashboard' (open at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffz8gzng09hc0f/fwgr72-n1-bench-dashboard), do two things and persist them: (1) Add the tag 'bench' to the dashboard — use the dashboard settings (gear icon) > General, and in the Tags field add the tag 'bench'. (2) Set the dashboard's time range to 'Last 6 hours' using the time picker in the top bar. Then SAVE the dashboard, and in the save dialog make sure the 'Update default time range' checkbox is TICKED so the 6-hour range is persisted into the saved dashboard (this is required — the time picker alone does not persist). Confirm the save succeeded. Then verify by reloading the dashboard page from the URL and report: the tags shown in the dashboard settings or breadcrumb, and the time range shown in the top bar time picker after the reload.
